venues.name: Close Company Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 9/22 (MOD JK/MKZ; 86/71).** Net $1,724 vs target $2,072 (-16.8%). Food $322. Comps $94.50. 62 guests, $27.82 check average. Bingo Tuesday drew a good crowd for meal deals — reminder to stay curious about food in the window so it reaches guests promptly. Bingo started with good vibes and a visit from Jess; opener left around 8pm and the barback handled prep. Strong end-of-night push, which the team noted guests now depend on. Kitchen had a smooth night. 86'd: Mr GinGin. No incidents. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: Close Company Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 9/22 (MOD & Chef MD/JMS; warm with a notable temperature drop).** Net $949 vs target $1,296 (-26.8%). Food $53. Comps $33.80 / 3.6% (bingo credits, industry, manager). 34 guests, $27.90 check average. Sleepier Tuesday than usual — the nicer weather may have pulled people elsewhere. Steady flow of groups in the first hours, but bingo saw limited participation with fewer guests in house. Held steady with industry guests until ~10:30pm, when 20–25 guests arrived within a few minutes and stayed for a round or two through last call, finishing with a couple celebrating a 30th birthday. John Michael held down the kitchen and was present on the floor with excellent guest interactions. Maintenance: Well 1 soda tap handle. Low: Cambio Repo. No incidents. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 9/22 (AM Carey; PM Maggie H; light sprinkles that didn't stop foot traffic).** Total net including events $11,946.59 vs target $7,764 (+53.9%). AM $941.02, D&C PM $7,319.57, net event sales $3,686. Total food including events $4,824 (event food $3,348). Comps $328.33. 196 guests (Tock), $60.95 check average. AM: light pops to start, two event service coffee supports, all side duties complete, fresh batch of mocha and cold brew ready at 9am. PM: busy night — back-to-back IRDs kept Maggie in the back; 8pm was the busiest stretch and 10:30pm popped with hotel guests wanting a nightcap. Events: two groups in Vauxhall and Suite 6A from 8am–5pm; Josh and Lucas W handled breakfast, lunch and afternoon snack spreads. The NACT group debriefed shortly after 10am and thanked the team for their hospitality; the Lauterbach meetings flowed smoothly. Justice was a great help over the last couple of days. Breaks made up; no incidents. Entered by Maggie H.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 9/22 (MOD & Chef Kyler and Steves; chilly).** Total EOD net including events $3,960 vs target $3,815 (+3.8%). Food $451, beverage $3,509. Comps $88.52 / 2.2%. 122 guests (Sevenrooms), $32 check average. A surprisingly energetic Tuesday after a chillier start to fall had the team braced for a quiet service. Calm through the 8pm flip, then the streets came out around 10pm. Kyler helped enormously even while hosting through the stickier turns. A highlight was guiding a group of bartenders visiting from Mexico, who didn't speak English, through the menu in service Spanish. Top sellers: Tripwire, Native Lion, Rosalie. Door: slow start with five solos at the bartop and a mix of two-tops, filled up around 8:30pm and stayed full to 11pm with a brief waitlist. A couple of Resy reservations didn't populate, but wait times stayed short. One no-show (Ciera George, 2 guests at 7pm), not charged. Breakage: one wine glass. Entered by Stefania.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 9/22 (MOD & Chef Julian and Saleh; nice 80-degree weather).** Net $4,276 vs target $3,728 (+14.7%). Food $806 (all marquee). Comps $184.50. 108 guests, $39.60 check average. Note: the form's date field was typed as 2026-09-23 and the notes reference a Wednesday, but the report posted just after midnight PT and covers Tuesday 9/22 service. Started slow (possibly the Dodger game), but by 8pm the whole room including the bar was full with a small waitlist. Every reservation showed. A few hiccups with DNL drinks — worth figuring out why certain drinks are consistently returned. A couple of investors came through, along with plenty of first dates and a few birthday celebrations. Hit the daily sales mark. Kitchen: one-man band killing it, though the milk was spoiled. 86'd: thai chili oil, milk. Maintenance: water filters arrived, to be installed tomorrow. Shoutouts to Madison for getting up to date on bar duties and Mr. George for covering for Ryan. Entered by Julian Catano.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 9/22 (MOD Josh/Marcus; drizzle).** Total net sales including events $7,106.49 vs target $3,519 (+101.9%). Marquee bar sales $3,749.04, event sales $3,700, food $588. Comps $99 (employee $8, manager $56, service recovery $35). 113 guests total — 89 walk-ins, 24 reservations, 49 cancellations; check average $62.89 (computed net/guests; the form's GCA field repeated the prior day's figures). A packed day: a Patrón masterclass at 2pm and a 5–7pm happy hour alongside Negroni Week specials. The Patrón happy hour was moved inside from the garden after Alex, scheduled to bartend the marquee, cut his finger on the underside of a truck riding down the alley and needed medical attention — the pivot worked out given light books and let Josh jump in behind the bar. After Josh left the team tried to keep the bar top unseated with only Sophia on bar, and she knocked out tickets all night. Chaz held the floor; a couple of hiccups on oyster ticket times. Tyler stayed to barback and touch tables and soft-closed Point Well with Josh; Devan hosted and helped touch tables through close. Natural last call around 11:30pm, room cleared by 12:15am. Kitchen: solid aside from oyster ticket times — going forward, clean oysters on arrival and store in the fridge, and only food runners should fulfill items on the KDS. Maintenance: curtain. No injuries reported beyond Alex's pre-shift accident. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Rainy from noon until 5, then partly cloudy
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 9/22 (AM Franck & Shannon; PM Justin & Drew; rain until 5pm then partly cloudy).** Total net $3,437 vs target $4,617 (-25.6%). Municipal Bar morning $560, evening $2,877; Sun Club and Hot Eye $0. Food $1,412. Comps $58.90. 89 guests (14 morning + 75 evening, OpenTable), $38.62 check average. Morning was slow with only a couple of tables at a time, plus double-digit tours at 1pm and 3:30pm. Evening started quiet with single digits on the books — the host was cut early and the shift lacked support roles. A nice walk-in pop at 6:30pm filled the banquettes, then the restaurant emptied by 9pm before an unexpected late pop of about 20 guests at tables and the bar who stayed well past close. Closed with just Carla Davis on the floor and two behind the bar. Crusher changed to the Gibson, and plenty went out after the switch. Sun Club closed early due to the wet weather with no sales. Kitchen had an easy night with no 86s or lows. No incidents. Entered by Justin.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Tuesday 9/22 (MOD Curtis Hayes; sunny and 70, lots of walk-ins from the game).** Net $9,203 vs target $8,000 (+15.0%). Food $1,326. Comps $554.55 / 6% (shifties plus high DNL comps, lots of celebrations and birthdays). 211 guests, $42.02 average guest spend. Another ripper — $9.2K on a Tuesday while down people. Illness continues to hit the roster: Anne Tesar flipped into a serving role and locked down 55-31 with panache, and Amber Johnson came into her swing running the 20s. Bar held solid with a ton of compendium calls. Several investors in, including Andrew Cheng. The night started with a weird vibe and pace — the music schedule has the same issues as the playlists, with odd downtimes between mixes and a lull right as the room started to pop; a curated playlist is highly suggested. Mariners home game drove decent foot traffic and the end-of-night crowd was loose. S'fian held down the kitchen solo and crushed it; prep may run a touch heavy tomorrow. 86'd/low: Pepita Orgeat. **Maintenance — urgent:** the bar reach-in freezer behind the service well is not functioning properly; ResQ has been contacted but has not yet scheduled a visit. No incidents. Entered by Curtis Hayes.
